text: The CEMS on the stack (00CQA10) measures NOx, CO, O2, NH3, flow and moisture (ER-12.04), and dust when firing LDO, with stack temperature and pressure for the conversion of the values to the reference conditions (dry, 15 % O2, standard conditions) of the emission limits of DP-CASE-0040 to DP-CASE-0042 (gas) and DP-OWNR-0041 to DP-OWNR-0043 (LDO).
